A.why: Compact and understandable, but applying model conversion after every form conversion broadens behavior unnecessarily, nullable boolean parsing remains incomplete, and no tests are added.

B.why: Targets the problematic field categories clearly while preserving other conversions, but lacks regression tests and explicit handling of nullable boolean search values.

C.why: The local conversion helper is well structured and tests cover both reported problems, but truthiness-based choices detection misses empty choices and boolean coverage omits valid tokens and nullable values.

D.why: Provides useful regression and boolean-token tests, but calling clean() for every form field introduces unrelated validation restrictions, and the manual boolean parser rejects explicit null values.

E.why: Uses focused conversion branches and includes an appropriate release note, but omits regression tests, typed multiple-choice handling, and explicit nullable boolean parsing.

F.why: The implementation is concise, but unconditional model conversion after form conversion affects unrelated field types, nullable boolean handling is incomplete, and tests are absent.

G.why: Separates conversion clearly and tests mixed-field search behavior, but adds unnecessary class-level machinery and fixtures, leaves an unused test variable, and misses nullable boolean coverage.

H.why: Keeps validation changes focused, but expands the inline branching with repeated form-field handling, misses empty choices and explicit null values, and adds no tests.
